name: Cade Walker
description:
Grew up in the slums of the city and had dreams of making a change. When he grew older, he either joined this city’s military force or law enforcement in a hopes to make the world a safer place as he experienced the awfulness of it first hand in the slums. But quickly he realized how corrupt the military/law enforcement was so he decided to abandon them and live life as a humble bounty hunter trying to make a real change. 

He would be a gunslinger type of bounty hunter that uses a hand cannon and rides a motorcycle. He has minimal cybernetics, mostly ones that enhance his bounty hunter abilities like agility, tracking, elusiveness, and gunslinging

trademarks.name: Revhead
features: Push a machine to its limits

drive: Make a real difference for the people under the thumb of the megacorps.
